decisions: How feasible is it to use Tree-Ring Watermarking for Rectified Flow Models (FLUX).

requirements.description: What are some benchmarks (e.g. Waves) for evaluating the watermark detection and how relevant is it for our use case?
Are we screwed if we lose the original text prompt? Can we use a VLM to guess it and still detect the watermark reliably?
How fragile is the detection? Does slight cropping or resizing of the image break it completely (check AUC drops)?
Is the 'noise inversion' step significantly harder or slower on Flow models compared to the standard DDIM inversion we use for SD 2.1?
Does embedding this watermark in the Fourier space visible degrade the image quality?
